video_description:
MiuiMix V13 on the Xiaomi 11T Pro — a custom MIUI 13 build running on Android 12, booting it up and walking the setup so you can see what you're downloading before you flash it.

MiuiMix is a community MIUI build, not an official Xiaomi release, so there's no warranty and no Xiaomi OTA behind it. In this clip I flash it on the 11T Pro and let it boot cold, then look through the settings and the launcher. If you're on stock MIUI and you've been wondering whether a tuned MIUI build is worth the evening, this is the quick version.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi 11T Pro
🧩 ROM     : MiuiMix V13
🤖 Android : 12

🎬 In This Clip
• Cold boot on the 11T Pro after the flash.
• First setup screens and the launcher as it lands.
• A quick look through settings, the parts that differ from stock MIUI.
• The download link, so you can grab the same build.

❓ Common Questions
• What do I need before I flash? An unlocked bootloader, a custom recovery like TWRP, and the ROM zip on internal storage.
• Will it wipe my phone? Yes. Moving from one MIUI base to a custom build always means a data wipe, so copy your photos off first.
• Do I need root? No. Root is separate — you can run this build completely unrooted.
• Is it an official Xiaomi ROM? No. It's a custom MIUI build, so treat it as one.
• Will bank apps work? That depends on the app and whether you root. On a clean unrooted flash, most work fine.
